description: Verify an address in 1-4 countries. $0.01 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/address/verify.

address.description: object (required) - structured components {unit?: string, street_number: string (required), street_name: string (required), street_type?: string, locality: string (required), state?: string, postcode: string (required)}

countries.description: array of strings - 1 to 4 country codes; each additional country beyond the first adds $0.005 to the call price

country.description: string - one country code (AU, US, CA, FR); supply either country or countries, not both

name: address_verify
